0.FACT_scale: largest for W (1.61), then q (0.93), then g (0.62), then Z (0.23), then t (0.11); it separates W jets from the rest best (AUC 0.92: large for W)
0.FACT_used_by: raises the score of W (+12%), t (+2%); lowers the score of Z (-23%); does not (or hardly) enter the score of g, q (share of each class score’s average input)

1.FACT_scale: largest for g (5.82), then t (2.98), then q (2.63), then Z (1.92), then W (1.77); it separates g jets from the rest best (AUC 0.93: large for g)
1.FACT_used_by: raises the score of g (+47%); lowers the score of q (-23%); does not (or hardly) enter the score of W, Z, t (share of each class score’s average input)
